messages.content: The Mission Bay resort says our two-queen room is out of service the first night. They offered either a king room with a rollaway and a move Sunday morning, or a larger room in another building for the whole stay at an added nightly charge. Can you confirm whether both actually accommodate three people and compare the real cost?

The resort confirms both options permit two adults and one 14-year-old. The temporary king room would have one king bed plus a twin rollaway; the rollaway is complimentary, but it reduces the open floor space. Staff would move the luggage after you vacate Sunday. The larger room has one king, a queen sleeper sofa, and occupancy for four. What nightly increase did they quote for that room?
They said $45 per night, but I do not know whether that includes tax or applies to all six nights.

It applies to all six nights. The room increase is $270, and the added lodging tax is $36.18, making the total upgrade $306.18. The resort charge does not change. The first option adds nothing, though you would need to repack, check out by 11:00 Sunday, and wait until the replacement two-queen room is ready, potentially as late as 4:00 p.m.
Would they store everything and text us when the room is ready? Also ask whether they can waive part of the larger-room increase since this started with maintenance.

Yes. Bell staff would collect and store the bags, then deliver them after the new room is assigned; the resort would text the number. They have also reduced the larger-room supplement to $30 nightly. That is $180 plus $24.12 tax, or $204.12 total for the stay.

At that difference, take the larger room for the full stay. I do not want Sunday morning tied up with packing and a room change. Keep the same cancellation deadline and make sure the balcony and bay view remain included.

The resort can retain the furnished balcony, bay-view category, and June 7 at 6:00 p.m. Pacific cancellation deadline. The revised lodging total will be $2,406.87. Shall I accept the modified reservation?
Yes, accept it. Since there is no move, leave Sunday morning as originally planned rather than building in hotel time.

The reservation is updated for June 14-20 to the larger bay-view room with a king bed, queen sleeper sofa, and furnished balcony for three guests. The new hotel total is $2,406.87, an increase of $204.12; confirmation MB-61483 and the cancellation deadline are unchanged. No Sunday room move is required, so the first full beach morning remains open as planned. The revised working trip total is $4,698.87.
